candidates.rule: Greedy, deterministic: highest score (3 decimals) first; equal scores prefer more open water, then depth nearer 80 m, then north, then west. No candidate within 10 km of a chosen one: twice the Mattilsynet 5 km norm (which already holds between new sites), so the 12 candidates of an area spread over it (GB)

current.rule: Annual mean current speed in the upper 30 m (TOPAZ4 monthly means 2018-2022): 0 at 0.01 m/s, 1 from 0.05 to 0.40 m/s, 0 at 0.8 m/s. GB: residual (non-tidal) currents at the 12.5 km model scale; existing sites span ~0.01-0.15 m/s (5-95 %)

depth.rule: Trapezoid: 0 at 15 m, 1 from 25 to 150 m, 0 at 300 m
depth.source: Owner brief 2026-10-20 (open pens ~25-150 m); GB ramps

exchange.rule: Water-exchange proxy: share of sea within 3 km (openness), 0 at 30 %, 1 at 80 %. GB proxy: enclosed basins (threshold fjords, pollen) have poor exchange; open sounds good
exchange.source: Proxy, documented in docs/geo/GEODATA.md; complemented by the Copernicus current layer

farm_distance.rule: Distance to the nearest active sea salmonid site: 0 at 2.5 km, 1 at 5 km
farm_distance.source: Mattilsynet letter 2022-01-21 (ref 2021/255437) to Vanylven kommune: 'anbefalt minsteavstand på 5 km i sjø mellom matfiskanlegg (laks) utenfor koordinerte brakkleggingsområder'

oxygen.rule: Lowest monthly mean dissolved O2 in the upper 30 m: 0 at 180, 1 at 250 mmol/m3. GB: salmon need > ~70-80 % saturation (~250 mmol/m3 at 10 °C). At the model's 25 km scale the upper 30 m never falls below ~255 mmol/m3 on this coast, so this never binds; sill-fjord basin hypoxia is below the pens and not resolved

temperature.rule: Mean over the 12 monthly means of the area (3 m): 0 at 2 °C, 1 from 8 to 16 °C, 0 at 20 °C
temperature.source: Optimum 13-16 °C, ITmax ~22 °C: Calado et al. 2021, Animals 11:1800; growth slows below ~4-5 °C: Alanärä et al. 2001 (as used in docs/BALANCE.md S2-03). Climatology: ProductionAreas.cs (Havforskningsinstituttet, Rapport fra havforskningen 2025-69)

waves.rule: Highest monthly mean significant wave height (winter exposure): 1 up to 1.2 m, 0 at 2.8 m. GB, calibrated on the registry: active sea salmon sites have a median of 0.5 m and a 95th percentile of 2.2 m on this measure, so open pens sit inside the skerries, not on the exposed outer coast

formula: score = (sum w_i c_i / sum w_i) x river_factor; 0 when a hard constraint holds

coral_closure.source: Forskrift om forbud mot fiske i korallrevområder (FOR-2016-01-08-8)

coral_reef.rule: Within 500 m of a recorded coral reef (MAREANO); GB: a mooring spread reaches about 3x the water depth, so a 150 m site's anchors lie up to ~450-500 m out

fairway.rule: Within the buffer of a main (hovedled) or secondary (biled) fairway centre line. GB, calibrated on the registry: no active sea salmon site lies within 250 m of a hovedled and 8 of 1050 within 100 m of a biled (Akvakulturregisteret 2026-10-20)
fairway.source: Kystverket, Hovedled og biled (2026); havne- og farvannsloven (LOV-2019-06-21-70) § 14

farm_too_close.rule: Closer than 2.5 km to an active sea site holding salmonids
farm_too_close.source: Mattilsynet's establishment guideline as cited in Naturvernforbundet's 2020 hearing statement: 2.5 km recommended minimum between sites of up to 3600 t MTB

land.rule: Land, lake or river cell (Kartverket N250)

national_salmon_river.rule: Aquaculture sites at least 5 km from a national salmon river (its mouth)

no_depth.rule: No depth data (outside Kartverket's grid and EMODnet)

outside_planning_area.rule: Open pens only: more than 1 nautical mile outside the baseline (grunnlinje), where municipal coastal-zone plans do not reach; sites farther out belong to the Havbruk til havs regime (offshore candidates)
outside_planning_area.source: Plan- og bygningsloven (LOV-2008-06-27-71) § 1-2: in the sea the Act applies out to one nautical mile outside the baselines; baseline from Kartverket N250 (Grunnlinje)

protected_area.rule: Inside a marine or marine-and-terrestrial protected area (naturvernområde)

salmon_fjord.rule: No new food-fish farms for anadromous fish inside a national salmon fjord
salmon_fjord.source: Forskrift om særskilte krav til akvakulturrelatert virksomhet i eller ved nasjonale laksevassdrag og nasjonale laksefjorder (FOR-2009-06-22-961) § 3, last amended 2023

too_deep.rule: Deeper than 300 m for open pens (GB: mooring limit of coastal pen systems)

too_shallow.rule: Shallower than 15 m (GB: a 10-15 m deep net needs clearance)

offshore.ranking: score (3 decimals) first; equal scores prefer depth nearer 200 m, then north, then west
offshore.rule: Inside a Havbruk til havs area; depth trapezoid 0 at 60 m, 1 from 100 to 350 m, 0 at 600 m (GB: OF1-class units are moored in ~100-300 m; the 2019 report mapped areas outside the baseline in workable depths)

river_factor.rule: score x factor, the factor rising linearly from 0.6 at an anadromous river mouth to 1 at 5 km. GB, scaled on the 5 km of FOR-2009-06-22-961 § 6 (lice pressure on wild salmonids)
